questions.text: Describe your approach to implementing Adobe Analytics.

lines: CJ03: Adobe Analytics upgrade to CJA [one-time]
C06: Audiences that act on the data [one-time]
sections: We would deliver this with Customer Journey Analytics.
We will plan the upgrade path, implement Web SDK alongside the Analytics source connector for history, port reporting API use and exports, and migrate projects and components.

We will define up to five audiences from AI-referred visits and their outcomes in the CJA data view, publish them to Real-Time Customer Profile, and agree with you how each audience is used in its existing channels.
draft.plain:
Our approach
- We would deliver this with Customer Journey Analytics.

What we would do
- We will plan the upgrade path, implement Web SDK alongside the Analytics source connector for history, port reporting API use and exports, and migrate projects and components.
- We will define up to five audiences from AI-referred visits and their outcomes in the CJA data view, publish them to Real-Time Customer Profile, and agree with you how each audience is used in its existing channels.

Sources
- Upgrade from Adobe Analytics to Customer Journey Analytics: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/analytics-platform/using/compare-aa-cja/upgrade-to-cja/cja-upgrade-recommendations
- Experience League: Publish CJA audiences: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/analytics-platform/using/cja-components/audiences/publish
- Learn about the Customer Journey Analytics Audiences publishing overview: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/analytics-platform/using/cja-components/audiences/audiences-overview
- Adobe: customer-journey-analytics.html: https://helpx.adobe.com/legal/product-descriptions/customer-journey-analytics.html

sells: The Client licenses Real-Time CDP or Journey Optimizer, because CJA audience publishing to Real-Time Customer Profile needs one of them; CJA alone does not license Profile Service.
The Client has licensed CJA Select, Prime or Ultimate (derived fields are not included in CJA Foundation).
